metadata.case_name: WU CHOI LAN v. TONGE (HONG KONG) LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: casual cleaning worker at construction sites

source: Two lacerations in her scalp were noted.
Physical and neurological examination at the Neurosurgical Department of QEH revealed a 4-cm scalp laceration over her left parietal scalp region. The laceration was sutured.
no doubt that the Plaintiff did suffer laceration on her head requiring suturing
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: Anterior wedge fracture / 40% wedge compression fracture of T-12 vertebral body
source: X-ray examination of the spine revealed anterior wedge fracture of T-12 vertebral body (Part III page 54 of Trial Bundle).
X-ray showed there was 40% wedge compression fracture of the T-12.
no doubt that the Plaintiff did suffer ... wedge compression of T-12

injuries.description: Abrasion / bruising and restricted movement of left shoulder (deltoid region bruising)
source: Left shoulder examination showed bruising at deltoid region.
no doubt that the Plaintiff did suffer laceration on her head requiring suturing, abrasion on her left shoulder, and wedge compression of T-12.
There was limitation of movement of the left shoulder with no evidence of nerve compression.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple superficial injuries of shoulder or upper arm

manifestations.description: headache (constant or intermittent; aggravated by weather changes)
dizziness / vertigo (intermittent, once or twice a month lasting 3-4 hours)
subjective impairment of concentration and memory (complained of poor memory)
restriction of movement of left shoulder / pain on lifting left arm / pain at left armpit
lower back pain (mid and lower back) / tenderness at thoraco-lumbar junction
pain aggravated by coughing, sneezing, walking, sitting for more than 10-15 minutes
numbness / tingling sensation in back, hips and occasional radiation to thighs and feet; numbness after walking for 15 minutes
inability / difficulty to squat, bend, jump; difficulty in bending and squatting; cannot walk for long
pain at sutured scalp site and sensitivity when wind blows

treatments_received: attended Accident & Emergency Department at Tseung Kwan O Hospital
transfer to Neurosurgical Unit of Queen Elizabeth Hospital
physiotherapy (multiple sessions at YFSMC and QEH)
treatments_future: 4 consultation visits for symptomatic treatment (as allowed by the Court)

losses.description: Difficulty in bending, squatting or jumping; cannot walk for long; numbness after walking for 15 minutes; pain aggravated by walking and sitting
Confined to bed and relied on daughter to assist during first three months after injury

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Difficulty in bending, squatting and lifting preventing performance of prior manual tasks (required assistance for some personal care and household tasks initially)
Unable to return to pre-accident labour-intensive cleaning work
Scalp laceration requiring suturing (possible scarring not otherwise quantified in the judgment)
